findings.issue: `rw [neg_mul, J_squared, neg_neg]` is literally the proof of `Matrix.neg_J_mul_J` that this PR adds at TauCeti/Algebra/Lie/Symplectic/Basic.lean:58-59, re-derived on the subterm `(-J l ℝ) * J l ℝ` instead of using the lemma. Same pattern at TauCeti/Algebra/Lie/Symplectic/Basic.lean:108-110, where `J * (-A) * (-J) * J` is normalised through `-(J * J)` and `J_squared` rather than `neg_J_mul_J`, which is 50 lines above in the same file.

summary: The mathematical content is new — Mathlib has no `mem_sp`, no J-conjugated transpose lemma, and no exp/symplectic material — but the proof scaffolding is a near-verbatim clone of the special-orthogonal pair of files in two places, and one lemma the PR itself adds is re-derived inline instead of used.
